Name: KNOWLEDGE_LOADSCREEN_ITEM_PARAM_ST
Description: Loading-screen tips. All rows (up to 256) are shuffled once; each loading screen shows the next eligible row in that order, wrapping around. A row is eligible when its unlock flag is on (or 0) and its disable flag is off.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The tip can only be shown while this event flag is on. 0: always available.

Fields.Name: Disable Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The tip is never shown while this event flag is on; takes priority over the unlock flag. 0: never disabled.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: ID of the tip's title in LoadingTitle and its body in LoadingText (the same ID in both).
